name: surf
description: Live crypto market, exchange, on-chain, wallet, and prediction-market data from Surf.

interface.longDescription: Research crypto markets with live prices, exchange data, wallet and token activity, DeFi metrics, on-chain SQL, equities, funds, and prediction markets through Surf's data tools. All tools are read-only: Surf does not place trades, move funds, or publish content. Public market data works without an account; wallet and portfolio lookups ask you to sign in to Surf.
defaultPrompt: Which tokens are leading the market today?
Compare BTC and ETH funding rates across exchanges.
Find active Bitcoin prediction markets and compare their odds.

positive.description: Current price of a major asset
positive.prompt: What is the current BTC price?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls surf_market with the price command for BTC and reports the latest USD price with its timestamp.

positive.prompt: Compare BTC and ETH funding rates on Binance.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls surf_exchange with funding-history for BTC/USDT and ETH/USDT and compares the latest rates without inventing exchanges that were not returned.

positive.prompt: Which DeFi protocols have the highest TVL right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls surf_project with defi-ranking and the tvl metric, then lists the top protocols with their TVL values.

positive.prompt: Find active Bitcoin prediction markets on Polymarket and Kalshi and compare their odds.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches prediction markets for Bitcoin, keeps the Polymarket and Kalshi platform labels, and compares probabilities only between markets that ask the same question.

positive.prompt: Who are the top traders on the Hyperliquid leaderboard?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls surf_hyperliquid with leaderboard and lists the top-ranked trader addresses with the performance figures returned.

review.commerce_description: Surf provides read-only market and on-chain data. It does not sell products, process payments, or execute trades.

publication.release_notes: Connects the Surf MCP server's ChatGPT profile (https://mcp.asksurf.ai/mcp/chatgpt). Read-only crypto market, exchange, wallet, token, project, on-chain, prediction-market, equity, and fund tools. News, web search, AI signal summaries, and X content are not included, addressing the v1.0.0 review feedback about third-party news content.
